channel.title: AIBuilder Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched, honest software reviews: real pricing, the honest knock, who should skip it. No hype, no invented numbers.

item.title: Surfer SEO Review (2026): The Monthly Rate Is a Yearly Deal
item.description: Surfer (SurferSEO) — Billed yearly: Discovery €49/mo, Standard €99/mo. Every tier quotes its monthly rate on annual billing.

item.title: Datarails Review (2026): Excel-Native FP&A, Quote Only
item.description: Datarails publishes three plans. You cannot find out what it costs without talking to sales, and the entry plan is smaller than it looks.

item.title: Scrolly Review (2026): Real Pricing, Real Limits
item.description: Scrolly: Free, and free is the only plan. The two features carry very different risk and the app presents them as one install.

item.title: TheTop Review (2026): From $15/mo, Checked Aug 2026
item.description: TheTop: Two paid plans, both month to month with no contract. Out-of-the-box integrations stop at Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook, Microsoft 365.

item.title: Fast Bundle Review (2026): Priced on Your Bundle Sales
item.description: Fast Bundle: The listing is free to install and shows four tiers. The most important thing about this app is not on its App Store listing.

item.title: TnC Review (2026): The Free Plan Is Dev Stores Only
item.description: TnC: Development Stores is free and carries every Pro feature.

item.title: Tidio Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo
item.description: Tidio: The free plan carries 50 billable conversations, 100 Flows visitors reached and 50 Lyro AI conversations.

item.title: Scarcity.AI Review (2026): Real Data, Tunable Truth
item.description: Scarcity.AI: The Low Stock Counter is $4.99 a month or $41.91 a year at a stated 30% saving, with a 7-day trial; its free tier is Development Stores.

item.title: Shipdock Review (2026): From $9.99/mo, Checked Aug 2026
item.description: Shipdock: Lite is $9.99 a month or $107.88 a year and is labelled 'only CSV'. Read the carrier list against your own country before anything else.

item.title: Way Review (2026): From $9.99/mo, Checked Aug 2026
item.description: Way: Basic is $9.99 a month or $95.90 a year and removes that branding. The pricing page reads like a feature ladder and behaves like a counter.

item.title: Koongo Review (2026): Trial Terms, Price & Limits
item.description: Koongo: Lite is $39 a month and updates every 6 hours, Starter is $79 and updates every 30 minutes. The headline price is a base, not a bill.

item.title: Meeri Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $4.99/mo
item.description: Meeri: Basic is free to install and covers up to 300 push notifications a month. The listing itself, read the same day, shows 4.6 from 9 reviews.

item.title: MigrationPro Review (2026): No Subscription, Pay Per Use
item.description: MigrationPro: Their homepage puts a typical store at $49 to $299 based on actual record counts. The listing tells you nothing about what this costs.

item.title: Storista Review (2026): Trial Terms, Price & Limits
item.description: Storista: AI-generated UGC video at roughly $1 to $4 a render, free to start with a $19 a month Pro plan. Same company, same name, unrelated ladders.

item.title: TiXel Review (2026): It Works, or It Tracks Nothing
item.description: TiXel: The other tier, Development Stores, is free but only for development and partner stores.

item.title: Essential Loyalty Review (2026): $10/mo Is the Entry Price
item.description: Essential Loyalty: Four tiers, and the meter is the whole decision. The meter is honest — loyalty-influenced orders, not all orders.

item.title: BackupMaster Review (2026): From $19/mo, Checked Aug 2026
item.description: BackupMaster: Essentials $19 a month or $205.20 a year, a 10% saving, covers stores up to 300 orders a month. The listing header says free to install.

item.title: Blocky Review (2026): From $9.99/mo, Checked Aug 2026
item.description: Blocky: Basic $9.99 a month or $83.92 a year, a 30% saving. Read the plan text before you read the badge.

item.title: Dondy Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $6.99/mo
item.description: Dondy: Pro $6.99 a month or $67.10 a year, a 20% saving. Automated cart recovery, campaigns and the official API begin at $79.99 a month.

item.title: ProtectMyOrder Review (2026): From $20/mo, Checked Aug 2026
item.description: ProtectMyOrder: The two pages sell different ladders. Start with the two pricing pages, because they do not describe the same product.

item.title: EcomXray Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo
item.description: EcomXray: Pro is $29 a month, with a 14-day free trial. The split between the two tiers is unusually clean, and worth seeing clearly.

item.title: Intelis Review (2026): It Counts Variants, Not Products
item.description: Intelis: Basic $49 a month or $490 a year, a 17% saving. The ladder counts variants, not products, and that is where stores get caught.

item.title: Selixer Review (2026): The Real Entry Price Is $299
item.description: Selixer: Three tiers, no free plan, each with a 14-day free trial. The profit waterfall, the product P&L and campaign POAS and ROAS tracking.

item.title: StoreFAQ Review (2026): Success Costs You Page Views
item.description: StoreFAQ: Enterprise $49.99 a month or $479.90 a year, a 20% saving. The meter is FAQ page views, and that is the thing this app exists to increase.

item.title: Tapita SEO Optimizer Review (2026): A 2.5x Price Spread
item.description: Tapita SEO Optimizer: +$5 on the Shopify Grow plan, +$30 on Advanced and +$60 on Shopify Plus. The price on the listing is a Shopify-Basic price.

item.title: AgentNest Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $19/mo
item.description: AgentNest — Four tiers, and the split between them is unusual: the diagnosis is free and you pay only for the repairs. Thirteen days old and no reviews.

item.title: AskNest Review (2026): Free Tier, Pricing Checked Aug 2026
item.description: AskNest: All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no paid tier shows a free trial — the free plan is the trial.

item.title: Castmagic Review (2026): From $19/mo, Checked Aug 2026
item.description: Castmagic: $19 a month billed annually, $239 a year, 30 transcribed hours, up to 3 Spaces, 50GB storage, 3 seats, no API access, no onboarding call.

item.title: ChatGPT AI Product Description Review (2026): From $19/mo
item.description: ChatGPT AI Product Description: Basic $19 a month or $190 a year (save 17%). 'ChatGPT AI Product Description' describes a category.

item.title: NeuroAds Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $19/mo
item.description: NeuroAds: Growth $49 a month or $468 a year (save 20%). Nothing about that is suspicious on its face; new apps have new reviews.
